visualCharacteristics.purpose: Flexible image-only promotional grids with named author-selectable layouts
visualCharacteristics.description: Equal tiles, a large square feature on either side, or a wide feature on either side.

contentPattern.structure: block heading: Layout Grid with a layout variant; each content row: image with optional destination link in a second cell
contentPattern.description: Choose a class-based variant, such as Layout Grid (Feature Right). Linked images follow in reading order; no property row or nested blocks.

usage: Choose a variant in the Block Inspector or use a heading such as Layout Grid (Feature Left). Three Columns is the default when no variant is set.
reuseGuidance: Use five images for Feature layouts, three for Wide layouts, or any count for equal columns.
